bio: Quinnie is a 25-year-old self-taught illustrator from Denmark, who’s been drawing all of her life. She got her first drawing tablet for digital art in 2014. Her work centers around conveying personality, character and depth, especially in her commissioned portraits, being very aware that somebody felt strongly enough for her subject to have a painting made of them, and so she strives to also capture this love. Most of the day she studies culture and history. She also loves writing, making music, studying story-telling and reading.
title: Quinnie Berning
